title: KM to Miles Distance & Speed Converter
metaDescription: Convert kilometers to miles (km to mi) and km/h to mph. Includes rapid mental conversion shortcuts, highway driving charts, and marathon running milestones.
directAnswer: To convert kilometers to miles, multiply the kilometer distance by 0.621371 (or divide by 1.609344). For example, 100 kilometers equals exactly 62.14 miles, and 5 kilometers equals 3.11 miles. For fast mental estimates on the highway, multiply the kilometer reading by six and drop the last digit (e.g., 50 km × 6 ≈ 30 miles).

faq.question: What is the exact conversion factor between km and miles?
faq.answer: 1 kilometer equals exactly 0.621371192 miles. Conversely, 1 international statute mile equals exactly 1.609344 kilometers.

faq.question: What is 100 km/h in miles per hour (mph)?
faq.answer: 100 km/h equals 62.14 mph, which represents the standard national highway speed limit in many European and Commonwealth nations.

faq.question: How many miles is a 5K and a 10K race?
faq.answer: A 5K road race is exactly 3.107 miles (commonly rounded to 3.1 miles), and a 10K race is exactly 6.214 miles.
